definitions: A three-dimensional representation of a person or thing or of a proposed structure, typically on a smaller scale than the original.
A person employed to display clothes or other merchandise.
A particular design or version of a product.
A system or thing used as an example to follow or imitate.
A simplified description, especially a mathematical one, of a system or process, to assist calculations and predictions.
examples: A model of the human heart.
She worked as a fashion model.
The latest model of the car.
The economic model of the country.
A computer model of the climate.
